lifecycleChecks.action: unplug and reconnect the Twitch, then restart the bridge if automatic recovery is unavailable
lifecycleChecks.expected: no crash or retry loop; process-restart recovery restores both Core MIDI directions
lifecycleChecks.result: pass-with-restart-policy: unplug caused one terminal device-not-responding completion, synchronous output abort, clean process exit and no retry loop; after reconnect the bridge recovered immediately; the already-running Mixxx process did not hot-discover recreated endpoints, but a normal Mixxx restart restored both directions and all states without controller reconfiguration

behaviorNotes: Hot cues are track metadata in Mixxx. Loading the same track on both decks intentionally shares its hot-cue set.

Normal AUTOLOOP pads are 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 beats. SHIFT-page pads are 0.03125, 0.0625, 0.125, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 and 4 beats; the first shifted pads therefore sound extremely fast by design.
CUE feedback follows Mixxx cue_indicator and therefore the selected Mixxx cue_mode. Cue mode 4 provides Mixxx behavior without blinking.
The final evidence captures are captures/20260811T175453.469Z-twitch-m4-bridge and captures/20260811T181502.652Z-twitch-m4-bridge.
